response.sql: SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439 GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive: high similarity means patsim >= 0.439.

alternatives.interpretation: If high similarity means strictly above the cutoff, exclude records with patsim = 0.439.
